changes.title: Resumed item-history accuracy
changes.text: Combining run segments no longer treats uncertain 'never equipped' history as an exact observation.

changes.title: Accurate per-unit comparisons
changes.text: Exact-depth and at-least-depth groups now use their own run, floor and turn denominators.

changes.title: Comparison integrity regressions
changes.text: Added checks for resumed-log uncertainty, preserved raw records, cached history and exact versus lower-bound comparisons.

changes.title: Verified build evidence
changes.text: Recorded TEST103's verified delivery and the next build's actual changes and checks.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I fixed two comparisons that could misrepresent incomplete run history. The recorded history stays intact, and uncertain values remain distinguishable from exact ones.
